additional_info.subject: RE: Ticket 0427160 has been closed. Are you satisfied with our provided solution? CRM:00315002697
additional_info.body:
Hi Chlöe,
Thanks for the question.
Our SECC uses a specific protocol that you can see in the logs called Coap, when this communication is dropped for 4sec, it sends an error and keeps the outlet unavailable until a reboot, or very rarely, recovering the communication by itself.
Most of the cases, it's a software issue where the timeout is just not long enough and after, for example, 5 secs it could return, since it was 4sec, it will go unavailable.
With this hotfix we are extending this timeout in order to have a smoother operation.
If this error reappears then we need to understand if it's actually a hardware issue.
I hope this was the information you needed. Please reply to this email because I still have access to the ticket even though it's closed.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
